# TechGeek.uz

TechGeek.uz is an independent smart-gadget seller serving Tashkent and customers across Uzbekistan.
The store sells original devices, provides an authenticity guarantee, and offers a one-month warranty for manufacturing defects.
Retail prices and current stock are confirmed by phone or Telegram. Listed website prices are wholesale prices for orders from 25 units.
